g.text: TIER 1: ON-DEVICE EDGE ARCHITECTURE (HOPE-FL INNER LOOP)
COMMUNICATION LAYER: Decoupled State Privacy & Parameter Gathering
TIER 2: NESTED FEDERATED SYNCHRONIZATION (FEDM3 OUTER LOOP)
• Adapts dynamically online with 0 backward passes!
• Local Differential Privacy: Per-sample gradient clipping (C = 1.0) with Gaussian noise perturbation (σ = 0.5)
with zero server visibility of individual client updates
• Projects updates onto Stiefel manifold St(p, n)
• Eliminates non-IID drift without central data
to all edge clients for Round t+1
